responsibility: Driver-side NVPTX offload image construction tool used by GCC’s OpenMP/OpenACC offloading flow. It locates and invokes the accelerator compiler to produce PTX, manages temporary files and environment/path setup, parses command-line options such as the offload ABI and OpenMP/OpenACC mode, then rewrites the generated PTX text into a C source file containing embedded PTX string objects plus recorded function/variable identifier mappings before compiling that wrapper back into a native object for host linking.
